label: Transcode media…
command: for f in "$@"; do omarchy-transcode -- "$f" || exit $?; done

label: Send via Taildrop…
command: status_json=$(tailscale status --json 2>/dev/null) || { command -v omarchy-notification-send >/dev/null 2>&1 && omarchy-notification-send -u critical "Taildrop" "Tailscale is not running or unavailable"; exit 1; }; [ -n "$status_json" ] || { command -v omarchy-notification-send >/dev/null 2>&1 && omarchy-notification-send -u critical "Taildrop" "No online Taildrop peers available"; exit 1; }; peers=$(printf '%s\n' "$status_json" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); su=str((d.get("Self") or {}).get("UserID") or ""); [print((p.get("DNSName") or "").rstrip(".") or p.get("HostName") or "") for p in (d.get("Peer") or {}).values() if p.get("Online") and not (p.get("DNSName") or "").rstrip(".").endswith(".mullvad.ts.net") and (p.get("TaildropTarget")==1 or (p.get("TaildropTarget") in (None,0) and su and str(p.get("UserID") or "")==su and not p.get("ExitNodeOption"))) and ((p.get("DNSName") or "").rstrip(".") or p.get("HostName"))]'); [ -n "$peers" ] || { command -v omarchy-notification-send >/dev/null 2>&1 && omarchy-notification-send -u critical "Taildrop" "No online Taildrop peers available"; exit 1; }; peer=$(printf '%s\n' "$peers" | omarchy-menu-select "Send via Taildrop") || exit 0; [ -n "$peer" ] || exit 0; exec omarchy-tailscale-send "$peer" "$@"
